demos.name: BasicUndoRedo
demos.description: In the following demo, undo-redo is available for the "edit" and "paste" operations.

demos.name: ToggleUndoRedo
demos.section: Basic usage › Disabling the undo and redo
demos.description: This removes existing history, prevents any further history from being tracked, and hides the undo/redo buttons from the toolbar.

demos.name: DataSourceUndoRedo
demos.description: The following demo shows the undo/redo feature working with a Data Source that supports row editing.

demos.name: CustomHandlers
demos.section: Custom history event handlers › Customizing default handlers
demos.description: - Keep undo/redo operations valid even when the cell is on a different page - Automatically navigate to the correct page when undoing/redoing

demos.name: AddFilterHandler
demos.section: Custom history event handlers › Creating a new handler
demos.description: To reduce the number of undo steps, changes on the filter model items that do not have a value are ignored.
